The auditor's fix (CH10_RELAY_ANSWER_BEATS 2 to 1, drop the reveal guard so K8 cuts K7 mid-reveal) would introduce a mid-typewriter overwrite — the exact defect class the 2026-08-10 run existed to kill — and break two tri-reconciled contract terms (the shared-anchor simultaneity binding and the tempo inequality that guarantees K7's 1.21s reveal completes before the answer) for a gain the musical repair achieves without collateral. The correct reading: K9's referent is the ASKING — the transmitted request, contracted as a two-bar sounding square-fifth figure at anc.ch10.relay-ask — not the caption paint. With D2 repaired, the answer at ask + 2 beats enters INSIDE the still-sounding two-bar question, the pause is filled by the asking itself, and the player hears the asking unfinished when the answer lands. The pillar spend becomes observation (audible) and K9 confirms it.

directions.ruling: Chapter-lane position: the owner's headed read is legitimate and it is exactly the risk my corridor-silence ruling accepted — silence is the coldest form of menace-by-procedure, but silence a player cannot distinguish from unfinished work has failed at the only place it matters. Note the ruling that produced it (CH-N1, preserved verbatim in chapter-reconciliation.jsonl) refused a REGULATION refusal line on the grounds that a refusal is an act and the station is never the actor, and that the station's first utterance is banked for the apron's traffic-control irony. Those grounds still hold; what they did not anticipate is that legibility of the closed door can be carried by the PLAYER'S OWN voice rather than the station's.
